approval_required_for: Implementation of planned_tool.current_vcs_compile_provenance_collector and planned_checker.current_vcs_compile_provenance_check only if the existing localization tools cannot produce a current hash-bound authorized VCS command/source expansion and legal monitor mapping.

Any proposed change to the exact user-supplied wrapper, compute-slot ABI, Vivado target selection or tool-profile policy, architecture/pipeline, memory layout, numeric policy, checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, expected outputs, or semantic-testbench contract. No approval is required for the read-only localization and hash-preserving bounded integration regeneration described above.

consumes: verification/board_interface/board_source_identity.json and its current source-closure, compute-slot ABI, and Vivado-facts hashes
prior_repair_execution_feedback and its differing input fingerprints
executable_actions.on_failure: Do not patch RTL, the exact user wrapper, the semantic testbench contract, or the generated monitor blindly. If existing tools cannot emit a current hash-bound expanded command/source authority and legal mapping, classify the missing capability as planned_tool.current_vcs_compile_provenance_collector with planned_checker.current_vcs_compile_provenance_check, request bounded approval for that capability implementation, and keep the board gate blocked.
produces: a current source/hash-bound expanded compile-source and command-authority record
a current source/hash-bound legal-monitor-mapping record for both mlp_down XMRs, or an explicit no-safe-mapping result
a repair-boundary record stating that operator_leaf_modules and single_transformer_layer_kernel remain unopened
executable_actions.rationale: The current-layer static gate rejects the simulation identity and VCS authority binding, while the pre-runtime VCS log identifies two unresolved generated-testbench XMRs. Produce one current-fingerprint causal context that distinguishes the invalid compile-plan binding from a legal monitor-path mapping. This is required before a bounded integration patch and replaces a runtime boundary trace that cannot exist before successful elaboration.

consumes: current exact Vivado export facts referenced by board_source_identity.json
generated board integration source containing spatialacc_exact_board_multilayer_tb.sv
executable_actions.on_failure: Reject the candidate and retain all SACG trust barriers. Do not bypass case_axi_ddr_interface, delete monitoring, substitute a simplified wrapper, choose an executable by name, or alter golden/numeric/model inputs. If the only possible remedy changes the exact wrapper, compute-slot ABI, Vivado target/tool-profile policy, or monitor contract, stop and request the corresponding bounded approval with the localization evidence.
produces: candidate verification/board_simulation/board_simulation_manifest.json with canonical identity-bound VCS authority
candidate generated board-monitor/testbench integration source with only the proven legal observation mapping
candidate compile-plan authority record with ordered source, macro/include, executable, identity, and Vivado-export references

candidate source-hash delta manifest proving the exact user wrapper source closure, compute-slot ABI, checkpoint, target-model reference, numeric policy, expected output, and semantic-testbench contract were unchanged
case_axi_ddr_interface rerun report for the candidate
executable_actions.rationale: Repair only the current board integration artifacts proven defective by the causal context: bind simulation.source_identity_sha256, compile authority, ordered-command authority references, and executable authorization to the current exact identity/Vivado facts, and replace the failing generated testbench XMR only with the proved legal observation mapping. This is a verification/integration repair, not a change to Transformer RTL, board wrapper behavior, golden outputs, or numeric policy.

consumes: candidate identity-bound board simulation manifest and canonical VCS compile-plan authority record
verification/model_reference/reference_manifest.json or current bound target-model reference manifest
current immutable checkpoint tensor catalog and deterministic/real input provenance
current immutable numeric comparison policy and tolerance
operator-leaf and single-layer certificates as read-only lower-layer evidence
executable_actions.on_failure: If compilation fails, return the new current-fingerprint compiler evidence to repair.board_current_source_authority_and_xmre_localization; do not infer an RTL fault. If runtime starts and fails, preserve its boundary trace and localize the earliest board boundary before any bounded board integration repair. Reopen a lower layer only if that trace directly contradicts a named current certificate invariant with core-start, complete-ingress, ready-egress, named-boundary, and certificate-hash evidence. On any failure, retain contamination barriers and open retry requests and do not promote to backend.
produces: verification/board_simulation/reports/compile.log, simulation.log, hierarchy_report.json, progress_event_log.jsonl, axi_protocol_report.json, pipeline_overlap_report.json, and runtime_loader_report.json when execution reaches the applicable phase
verification/case_diagnostics/vcs_functional_diagnosis.json and a current hash-bound boundary trace or compile-failure localization
verification/semantic_evidence/board_axi_ddr.json only if all prerequisite board evidence exists
fresh board numeric, data-order, AXI/DDR, liveness, runtime-loader, and output-validity reports using target-model expected output
SACG update retaining barriers on failure or recording a Stage7-rerun candidate for promotion only after every required checker passes
executable_actions.rationale: Only after the repaired static board contract passes, rerun the real VCS board closure and its dependent board checks against the immutable semantic evidence. This supplies either successful board evidence or a fresh current-fingerprint compile/runtime CCTG localization. It is the required current-layer replay; it is not permission to promote or to reopen certified lower layers.

observations: The exact user-supplied board source identity itself passed: it is hash-bound by path, selected simulation-source closure, compute-slot ABI, AXI interfaces, timing contract, and Vivado facts. The failing case_axi_ddr_interface gate instead proves that the board simulation manifest and its ordered VCS commands do not bind that current identity, the exact Vivado export authority, or an authorized executable.

The VCS diagnostic is a pre-runtime board integration/testbench failure, not hardware functional evidence: spatialacc_exact_board_multilayer_tb.sv lines 255 and 257 reference unresolved dut.spatialacc_single_kernel.core.mlp_down_io_in_valid__bore and mlp_down_io_in_ready__bore. Compile terminated before elaborated-hierarchy evidence, simulator progress events, AXI monitor results, loader reports, output comparison, or a runtime CCTG frontier existed.

The prior repair-execution request for ACTIVATION_AXI_BEATS_PER_TOKEN provenance is not a sufficient patch basis for this candidate: its recorded input fingerprint differs from the current VCS diagnosis binding, and the current supplied compiler error identifies different unresolved mlp_down references. It remains useful only as a warning to obtain current source/hash/command provenance before changing generated integration sources.

The hierarchical context certifies all operator-leaf gates and all connected single-layer gates. It also certifies elastic variable-latency token-pipeline behavior: boundary order and required cross-token overlap matter, while same-cycle stage completion is not required. The current board records provide no direct lower-layer contradiction, so the lower layers remain closed.

The runtime-dependent board reports are missing because execution never started; their absence is downstream of the static authority failure and XMRE, not independent evidence of AXI, DDR, numeric, weight-loader, pipeline, or liveness RTL failure.

Authoritative SACG truth has 16 active scoped contamination barriers: contamination_barrier.0329, .0330, .0331, .0341, .0342, .0343, .0344, .0345, .0346, .0347, .0348, .0349, .0350, .0351, .0352, and .0353. They keep rejected Stage7 and Stage8 artifacts as planning/debug evidence only.

Authoritative SACG truth also has open retry_request.0136, .0140, .0141, .0142, .0143, and .0144, all requiring bounded repair followed by a Stage7 verification rerun. There is no scoped open backtrack request; omitted cross-layer backtrack history is not an executable blocker for this board-scope decision.
The conditional design-team router returned no_split. That does not change the evidence requirement or authorize promotion.
proposed_actions: Perform current-board static causal localization before any RTL repair or runtime boundary replay. Resolve the current exact board identity, Vivado-export-backed command authority, expanded source closure, and legal generated-testbench observation mapping for the two XMRE references.

Regenerate only the board simulation manifest/compile authority and generated board-monitor integration slice that the localization proves defective. Preserve the exact wrapper closure and immutable semantic verification contract; then rerun case_axi_ddr_interface before VCS.

After the static contract passes, execute the real board VCS and the dependent board gate DAG on the unchanged target-model reference, checkpoint, stimulus, numeric policy, semantic-testbench contract, and full weight catalog. If execution reaches runtime and fails, use its fresh current-layer CCTG trace for the next bounded board repair; do not reopen lower layers absent the required direct contradiction.
risks: A manifest-only repair can accidentally select an unauthorized simulator command, stale Vivado export, stale source closure, or a different wrapper. The repaired compile plan must be derived from and hash-bound to the current exact board identity rather than guessed from names or historical commands.

The XMRE must not be repaired by deleting required frontier monitors or inventing an internal signal path. Any monitor remap must be proven against the current source hierarchy and must preserve required lifecycle/pipeline observation semantics; changing user wrapper ports, compute-slot ABI, or accelerator RTL is outside this bounded repair.

Model, shape, numeric policy, tensor ordering, memory/runtime image, loader schedule, implementation source closure, and board facts can diverge even after compilation succeeds. In particular, static board_consumed_tensor_hashes do not prove runtime consumption; a successful run must prove complete target-layer loading, no early kernel start, and target-model comparison using the immutable checkpoint and stimulus.
There is currently no board output/lifecycle-frontier evidence. Independent prefetch or AXI activity after a rerun would not prove output progress, completion, or lower-kernel failure.

Changing tolerances, checkpoint, stimulus, expected output, semantic-testbench contract, or exact wrapper source hashes to make the rerun pass is prohibited. Expected outputs must continue to come from independent target-model inference for the same immutable input/checkpoint.

The active SACG barriers and retry requests prevent using this repair plan, the failed reports, or any candidate rerun outputs as validated downstream inputs until the required current-layer checks pass and Stage7 promotes the new evidence.

constraints: Do not modify the exact user-supplied board wrapper, source closure, compute-slot ABI, checkpoint, stimulus, target-model expected outputs, numeric policy/tolerances, semantic-testbench contract, or accelerator scope.
Do not replace missing board execution with a smoke test, random expected outputs, static weight manifests, RTL-derived golden data, or a simplified wrapper.

The generated board testbench may be changed only as a bounded instrumentation/integration repair after current-source localization proves a legal existing observation mapping; it must not remove required monitors or alter the semantic testbench contract.

Do not reopen operator leaves or the connected kernel without a current hash-bound board trace containing direct start, complete ingress, ready egress, a named earliest causal boundary, and a contradiction of a named lower-layer certificate invariant.
All active scoped contamination barriers remain downstream-consumption blockers until a successful current Stage7 rerun creates promotable evidence.
edges: exact_sample_board_source_identity plus bound Vivado export facts -> canonical_vcs_compile_plan -> case_axi_ddr_interface -> fresh VCS elaboration/execution -> current board CCTG trace -> board gate DAG
current immutable checkpoint, stimulus, target-model reference, numeric policy, semantic-testbench contract, and complete tensor catalog -> independent board numeric comparison
operator-leaf and connected-kernel certificates -> reusable lower-layer evidence only; they do not imply board AXI/DDR or backend readiness
active Stage7/Stage8 trust barriers and retry requests -> repair execution plus successful Stage7 rerun before any promotion

output.summary: Fail-closed decision: keep board_axi_ddr_closure blocked from backend synthesis, implementation, bitstream, runtime-ABI release, and board runtime. Repair and revalidate the current board AXI/DDR verification/integration contract first: the earliest executed gate failure is case_axi_ddr_interface, whose board-simulation identity and canonical VCS compile authority are not bound to the exact current board identity/Vivado facts. A prior VCS attempt also stopped at a generated-board-testbench XMRE before runtime. No board functional, AXI, DDR, liveness, lifecycle-frontier, numeric, data-order, or executed DUT-weight-consumption claim is available. Certified operator-leaf and connected single-layer evidence remains read-only reusable evidence; no current hash-bound board trace contradicts a lower-layer invariant, so no lower-layer reopening is authorized.
